title: Seeing vs. Counting: Complexity Twins Show Where Multimodal LLMs Fail on Diagrams
abstract: arXiv:2611.08998v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a multimodal LLM miscounts in a diagram, does it fail at seeing or at counting? Existing visual graph and puzzle benchmarks vary visual density and algorithmic hardness together, confounding the two. We pair counting questions about the same drawing that sit in different counting-complexity classes, such as its spanning trees (a determinant) and its simple paths (#P-complete), and use a transcription probe and a text-only control to separate reading from computing. We test Gemini, Gemma and Qwen3-VL models; for the Gemini models, the answer depends on how the model computes. In chain of thought, most of them read small drawings correctly and then fail at counting, at a rate set far more by the size of the answer than by its complexity class (for the primary model, the odds of an exact answer fall 2.38-fold per decade of the answer). translated_title: 看见与计数：复杂性孪生问题揭示多模态大语言模型在图表上的失败之处
translated_abstract: 当多模态大语言模型在图表中数错时，它是在“看见”上失败了，还是在“计数”上失败了？现有的视觉图与谜题基准将视觉密度与算法难度同时变化，混淆了这两个因素。我们对同一幅图配对提出属于不同计数复杂性类别的计数问题，例如其生成树数量（一个行列式）与其简单路径数量（#P完全），并使用转录探针和纯文本对照来将“读取”与“计算”分离开来。我们测试了Gemini、Gemma和Qwen3-VL模型；对于Gemini模型，答案取决于模型如何计算。在思维链模式下，大多数模型能够正确读取小图，随后在计数环节失败，其失败率主要由答案的大小而非其复杂性类别决定（对于主要模型，答案每增大一个数量级，精确回答的几率下降2.38倍）。在给定代码和精确转录的情况下，主要模型即使在10x10的网格上也能正确计数，而且……
tldr: 该论文通过在同一图上配对不同计数复杂性类别的“复杂性孪生”问题，并辅以转录探针和纯文本对照，将多模态大模型的“看见”与“计数”能力分离，发现模型主要在计数环节失败且失败率取决于答案大小而非复杂性类别，而在提供精确转录和代码时模型可以正确计数。
en_tdlr: By pairing "complexity twin" counting questions on the same diagram across different complexity classes, along with transcription probes and text-only controls, this paper disentangles seeing from counting in multimodal LLMs, showing they read small diagrams correctly but fail at counting at a rate set by answer magnitude rather than complexity class, while exact transcription plus code enables correct counting.
